questions.stem: As light intensity increases, the rate of photosynthesis initially increases. Why does the rate eventually level off?

options.text: The plant runs out of chlorophyll
Another factor such as CO2 concentration or temperature becomes limiting
The stomata close to prevent water loss
Too much light damages the chloroplasts

questions.explanation: When light is no longer limiting, another factor such as carbon dioxide concentration or temperature becomes the limiting factor, preventing the rate from increasing further.
